component.name: MeasureProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.seq = 0 ' Populate the lists/grids before measuring; content drives their laid-out extent. m.top.findNode("labelListA").content = makeContent(3) m.top.findNode("labelListB").content = makeContent(3) m.top.findNode("posterGridA").content = makeContent(6)
' Measure after a settle delay: bounding rects are only meaningful once the node has been ' laid out, and reading in init() reports pre-layout zeros everywhere. m.settleTimer = m.top.findNode("settleTimer") m.settleTimer.observeField("fire", "onSettled") m.settleTimer.control = "start" end sub
function makeContent(count as integer) as object root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to count - 1 item = root.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = "Item " + itos(i) end for return root end function
sub onSettled() p("all", "start", "") measureLabelList() measurePosterGrid() measureRotation() measureRenderTracking() p("all", "done", "") m.top.probeExit = true end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' L: LabelList honors rowHeights / rowSpacings? '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- sub measureLabelList() a = m.top.findNode("labelListA") b = m.top.findNode("labelListB")
' Overridden list: rowHeights [100,50,200] + rowSpacings [10,20]. ' honored -> height 100+50+200 + 10+20 = 380 ' ignored -> 3 * itemSize.y (+ whatever per-row gap) ~= 120..123 p("L-labellist", "with-overrides", "rect=" + r(a.boundingRect()) + " itemSize=[300,40] rowHeights=[100,50,200] rowSpacings=[10,20]")
' Control: no overrides at all. Isolates the plain per-row pitch, including whether the ' device really adds the engine's undocumented +1 per row. p("L-labellist", "no-overrides", "rect=" + r(b.boundingRect()) + " itemSize=[300,40] expect-3-rows")
' boundingRect is the MEASURED extent; subBoundingRect (when supported) reports where a ' row was actually laid out. brs-engine already reports per-row heights in the measured ' extent (PR #1134) while LabelList's render loop still advances by itemSize.y + 1, so ' these two can disagree - which is precisely what needs settling on hardware. p("L-labellist", "rows-with-overrides", "row0=" + r(a.subBoundingRect("0")) + " row1=" + r(a.subBoundingRect("1")) + " row2=" + r(a.subBoundingRect("2"))) p("L-labellist", "rows-no-overrides", "row0=" + r(b.subBoundingRect("0")) + " row1=" + r(b.subBoundingRect("1")) + " row2=" + r(b.subBoundingRect("2"))) end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' P: PosterGrid spacing fall-back when the array is SHORTER than the track count '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- sub measurePosterGrid() g = m.top.findNode("posterGridA") ' 3 columns of 100 with columnSpacings=[10] and itemSpacing.x=50: ' last-entry repeats -> 300 + 10 + 10 = 320 ' falls back to itemSpacing -> 300 + 10 + 50 = 360 ' 2 rows of 100 with rowSpacings=[10] and itemSpacing.y=50: ' repeats -> 210 ; falls back -> 210 as well (only ONE gap for 2 rows), so the ' column axis is the discriminating one here. p("P-postergrid", "short-spacing-arrays", "rect=" + r(g.boundingRect()) + " cols=3 rows=2 poster=100x100 itemSpacing=[50,50] columnSpacings=[10] rowSpacings=[10]") end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' R: does an inherited rotation rotate a child's own translation? '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- sub measureRotation() gChild = m.top.findNode("rotGroupChild") rChild = m.top.findNode("rotRectChild")
' Container at [600,320] rotated 90 deg, child translated [100,0]: ' translation rotated -> child lands ~[600, 420] in scene space ' translation NOT rotated -> child lands ~[700, 320] ' Same host shape both times; only the CHILD's node type differs. In the engine a Group ' child does not rotate its own translation while a Rectangle child does, so these two ' rows disagreeing IS the divergence. On a device they should agree with each other. p("R-rotation", "group-child", "child-scene=" + r(gChild.sceneBoundingRect()) + " host=[600,320] rot=90deg child-translation=[100,0]") p("R-rotation", "rectangle-child", "child-scene=" + r(rChild.sceneBoundingRect()) + " host=[900,320] rot=90deg child-translation=[100,0]") end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' T: does clippingRect participate in renderTracking? '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- sub measureRenderTracking() on = m.top.findNode("trackOnscreen") clipped = m.top.findNode("trackClipped") noclip = m.top.findNode("trackNoClip")
p("T-tracking", "inside-onscreen-clip", "renderTracking=" + on.renderTracking + " expect=full") ' The discriminating case: the node itself is on screen and fully inside its clippingRect, ' but that clippingRect is positioned entirely off screen. p("T-tracking", "inside-offscreen-clip", "renderTracking=" + clipped.renderTracking + " reference-says=none") ' Control: an offscreen node with no clip at all - "none" here is expected on both. p("T-tracking", "offscreen-no-clip", "renderTracking=" + noclip.renderTracking + " expect=none") end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Helpers '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function r(rect as object) as string if rect = invalid then return "<invalid>" out = "{x=" + n(rect.x) out = out + " y=" + n(rect.y) out = out + " w=" + n(rect.width) out = out + " h=" + n(rect.height) return out + "}" end function
' Round to the nearest integer: sub-pixel differences are not what any of these cases are ' about, and rounding keeps the trace stable across device/engine float handling. function n(v as dynamic) as string if v = invalid then return "?" if v >= 0 then return itos(int(v + 0.5)) return itos(-int(-v + 0.5)) end function
function itos(i as integer) as string return str(i).trim() end function
sub p(phase as string, caseId as string, detail as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = itos(m.seq) while s.len() < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + phase + "|" + caseId + "|" + detail end sub
